g.aria-label: Analytical Loss Floors: floor(t) = c_t² E[tr Cov(x₀ | x_t)]
c_t = 1 · Floor: 0 at t → 0 to tr Cov(x₀) at t → 1
At t = 0, x_t = x₀ is known (floor = 0); at t = 1, posterior is prior
c_t = −α_t/σ_t · Floor: d = 2 at t → 0 to 0 at t → 1
Average floor ≈ 0.54; at t → 1, x_t ≈ ε is known (floor → 0)
c_t = −1/t · Floor: d = 2 at t → 0 to ≈ 9 near t = 0.9
Average floor ≈ 4.91 (9× higher than VP noise from c_t² = 1/t²)
Never compare raw loss values across targets; rank models by excess over floor
